mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.stated_objective_pain_point: Support fast, flexible, transparent preliminary CubeSat mission design by combining CE and MBSE with standardized calculation sheets, a central repository, and a CubeSat technology database.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.system_boundary_and_abstraction: Phase 0/A feasibility and preliminary design from conceptual design to subsystem sizing and component selection. Detailed hardware/software integration, environmental testing, operations validation, and formal V&V artifacts are outside the demonstrated boundary.

required_prior_behavioral_domain_knowled.summary: The paper does not explicitly frame a minimal behavioral-knowledge method. S3D sheets include theory/equations and typical literature values; users still provide mission analysis/system inputs and external-analysis outputs. CUTE-DB reduces component-knowledge burden by listing current COTS specifications.

model_artifact_details.S3D_calculation_sheets: Excel spreadsheets for ADCS, CommSys, EPS, propulsion, thermal, optical payload, risk, and cost, each with cover/change log/theory/input/sizing/budget/constants sheets.
model_artifact_details.central_data_exchange: Repository sheets for mission design, mission analysis, launch vehicle, structure/configuration, ADCS, CommSys, EPS, propulsion, thermal, payload, and mass/volume budget, with linked inputs/outputs and checks.
model_artifact_details.CUTE_DB: Excel technology database with TRL, origin, item/developer/physical/functional/environmental/power/flight-heritage/price fields.
model_artifact_details.case_artifacts: ConOps trade-off table, mass/volume budget, cost/risk assessments, component selections, and final presentation.

mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.excluded_or_minimal_elements: No formal SysML/Capella model, requirements diagrams, verification matrices, test procedures, or public reusable package are reported.

reported_steps_or_phases.activities: Develop S3D discipline calculation sheets, Central Data Exchange System, CUTE-DB, and user manuals.
reported_steps_or_phases.inputs: Literature equations/typical values, mission/system parameters, online/developer component data.
reported_steps_or_phases.outputs: Sizing/budget spreadsheets, central shared data, technology database.

reported_steps_or_phases.step: Session 1: Kick-off and start of mission design
reported_steps_or_phases.activities: Present mission objectives, requirements, drivers; perform preliminary mission analysis; identify ConOps and architectures; initiate cost/risk assessment.
reported_steps_or_phases.outputs: Mission statement/objectives, initial ConOps/architecture options, preliminary cost/risk.

reported_steps_or_phases.activities: Consolidate ConOps and mission architecture; iterate mission analysis/Delta-V; define system architecture and preliminary subsystem architectures; refine cost/risk.
reported_steps_or_phases.outputs: Selected ConOps, Delta-V estimate, system/subsystem architecture baseline candidates.

reported_steps_or_phases.activities: Compute system/subsystem budgets, conduct preliminary subsystem sizing, use CUTE-DB for component options meeting criteria/requirements.
reported_steps_or_phases.outputs: Subsystem sizing, preliminary COTS component choices, budgets.

reported_steps_or_phases.activities: Conclude iterations, select subsystem-level components, compute final budgets, finalize cost/risk and mitigation actions.
reported_steps_or_phases.outputs: Baseline mission/system design, final mass/volume/cost/risk information, final presentation, lessons learned.

implementation_pathway_tailoring.actors_roles: 12-member team: project manager, system engineer, payload, mission analyst, propulsion, ADCS, EPS, C&DH, CommSys, TCS, structure/configuration, and risk/cost engineers.
implementation_pathway_tailoring.handoffs_and_completion_criteria: Each session ends with internal presentations, discussion of results, and definition of next steps; final session consolidates baseline and component selections.
implementation_pathway_tailoring.mapping_to_systems_engineering_lifecycle: Explicitly phase 0/A; no SRR/PDR/CDR mapping is reported, but the workflow supports preliminary baseline selection and transition to later phases conceptually.

toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.toolchain_architecture_data_flow: Discipline experts enter mission/system inputs into S3D spreadsheets; selected inputs/outputs are linked to the Central Data Exchange System; CUTE-DB supports COTS component selection; STK/SolidWorks analyses feed manually into relevant central sheets; final results are reviewed via presentations.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.syntax_semantic_lifecycle_continuity: Shared spreadsheet fields and Check columns maintain common assumptions across mission/system/subsystem levels during phase 0/A. No formal exchange standards, semantic model transformations, or lifecycle traceability schemas are reported.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.software_hardware_system_integration_rea: Supports preliminary system integration by aligning subsystem budgets and component selections; no direct software/hardware integration or testbed readiness evidence is reported.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.availability_reproducibility: No public S3D/CUTE-DB model files are reported. The paper describes structure, sources, and update date; reproducibility is partial and would require access to the tools/manuals.

eps_verification_specific.eps_elements_notes: EPS is included as a discipline spreadsheet and CUTE-DB category; BOSS mass/volume budget lists PCDU + battery pack, deployable solar arrays, and solar array with margins.

eps_requirements_representation.summary: Mission-specific criteria/requirements are mentioned for component selection, but formal EPS requirements and links to architecture/behavior/verification artifacts are not shown.

eps_verification_specific.verification_integration_evidence: Central-repository checks validate common inputs and sizing/budget consistency before physical development; there is no evidence of verification procedures integrated into an EPS model.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: The CE-MBSE/concurrent model-based approach shortens the BOSS feasibility analysis relative to the traditional methodology.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_process_linked: Four concurrent design sessions using S3D calculation sheets, CUTE-DB, and a Central Data Exchange System.
evidence_type: Quantitative comparison with baseline or counterfactual
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Feasibility analysis duration reported as 1 month with CE-MBSE versus 3 months with the traditional methodology.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.evidence_quote: Using the CE-MBSE methodology, the feasibility study was completed in one month, compared to the three months required when using the traditional approach.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: Comparator details are limited; authors note the shown results only include the four sessions and not post-study refinement.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: The CE-MBSE approach reduces the estimated mission cost for the BOSS feasibility study compared with a traditional methodology.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_process_linked: Concurrent design sessions, cost spreadsheet, shared assumptions, and early cross-discipline iteration.
evidence_type: Quantitative comparison with baseline or counterfactual
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Cost assessment is 15M€ for CE-MBSE versus 22M€ for traditional methodology.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.evidence_quote: The CE-MBSE approach projected a total mission cost of 15 million euros, which is significantly lower than the 22 million euros estimated through the traditional approach.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: The paper says the lower cost likely stems from minimized redesigns and optimized resources, but does not provide the cost model details or independent validation.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: The CE-MBSE workflow produced different/lower mass and other feasibility figures of merit, interpreted as evidence of integrated iterative design effectiveness.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_process_linked: Central Data Exchange System mass/volume budgets, S3D sizing sheets, and BOSS feasibility comparison.
evidence_type: Quantitative comparison with baseline or counterfactual
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Mass budget 22.59 kg with CE-MBSE versus 26.6 kg traditional; Delta-V 1.33 m/s versus 0.68 m/s.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.evidence_quote: The CE-MBSE methodology resulted in a spacecraft mass of 22.59 kg, which is approximately 15% lower than the 26.6 kg calculated using the traditional methodology.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: Mass reduction is attributed as likely due to the integrated approach; Delta-V result favors traditional refinement and is affected by differing time allocation.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: The Central Data Exchange System improves cross-discipline consistency, validation, and error reduction by sharing up-to-date data and checking common inputs.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_process_linked: Linked Excel central repository with Inputs/Outputs tables and Check column for common input values.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Faster validation, less manual effort, and fewer errors are claimed qualitatively; no error counts are measured.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.evidence_quote: It allows automated data transfer from the other spreadsheets of the S3D Tool and enables faster validation of the sizing, budgets and design, reducing manual effort and minimizing errors.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: No measured defect reduction or validation-time metric is reported; external tools still require manual entries.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: Concurrent sessions and shared tools improve collaboration, communication, and cross-disciplinary alignment.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_process_linked: Concurrent design sessions, C²DF team setup, shared S3D/CUTE-DB tools, internal presentations.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Qualitative claim of enhanced collaboration, consensus decisions, and resource sharing.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.evidence_quote: the team continuously communicates, discusses, and takes decisions by consensus
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: No stakeholder survey, communication metric, or independent assessment is reported.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: CUTE-DB supports component selection and decision making by linking available CubeSat technology specifications and performance data to preliminary design.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_process_linked: CUTE-DB component database and S3D discipline spreadsheets used from Session 3 for COTS component selection.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: The database enables immediate access to COTS specifications and component options; no selection-quality metric is reported.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.evidence_quote: The CUTE-DB provides immediate access to specifications and performance data of commercially available components, supporting not only the component selection during the design process but also ensuring that CubeSat projects are based on current technological realities.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: Database completeness/data quality and update processes are not evaluated beyond source/update description.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: The Concurrent Model-Based approach and tools are reusable across multiple CubeSat/small-satellite mission case studies.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_process_linked: S3D Tool, Central Data Exchange System, CUTE-DB, and adapted four-session concurrent workflow.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Authors report application/testing in BOSS, Geo-Profundo, and a cislunar in-orbit servicing case; only BOSS is detailed in this paper.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.evidence_quote: the Concurrent Model-Based approach and the related tools (both S3D Tool and CUTE-DB) have been implemented and tested in several case studies, including the Bennu Observer Small Satellites (BOSS) mission, the Geo-Profundo mission [13], and the Cislunar mission [15].
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: Only one case has detailed results in the paper; other cases are briefly described or referenced.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: Early model integration and concurrent refinement can identify risks/issues earlier and allow verification to begin before traditional approaches.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_process_linked: Integrated models/tools, risk assessment spreadsheets, and consistency checks.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Conceptual claim only; no verification artifact results, risk-reduction metric, or test evidence is shown.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.evidence_quote: Parallel system development and early identification of potential issues and risks ensures a continuous refinement of the models and leads to optimized system design.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: The paper does not provide risk metric changes, formal verification model evidence, or physical/integration test outcomes.

governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.traceability_to_project_deliverables_or_: Linked sheets feed baseline budgets/component selections and final presentations. Formal traceability to requirements, assurance cases, management reports, or lifecycle gates is not reported.
governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.evaluation_criteria_for_model_quality_or: Figures of merit include mass budget, Delta-V budget, cost assessment, and feasibility analysis duration; authors also collect lessons learned after the final presentation.
governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.roi_notes: No cost of MBSE adoption, training/tooling effort, or independent ROI calculation is reported. Mission cost estimate and feasibility duration favor CE-MBSE in the BOSS comparison.
governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.programmatic_gates_or_critical_events_su: Phase 0/A feasibility baseline selection and session reviews; no SRR/PDR/CDR evidence.

gap_mapping_notes.practical_implementation_pathway: Four-session workflow, roles/tools, inputs/outputs, and BOSS case outputs are described.
gap_mapping_notes.toolchain_fragmentation_interoperability: Central repository and linked spreadsheets address interoperability but external analyses remain manual.
gap_mapping_notes.lightweight_resource_constrained_tailori: ESA CDF is compressed into four sessions for CubeSat phase 0/A work and low-cost/fast missions.
gap_mapping_notes.governance_project_deliverables_roi: Final presentation, baseline, figures of merit, and cost/schedule comparison are present; formal governance and adoption ROI are shallow.
gap_mapping_notes.newspace_agile_distributed_rapid_iterati: Concurrent, rapid, collaborative sessions align with rapid-iteration demands, but NewSpace is not explicitly named.

key_findings_by_rq.RQ1: Supports a general system-level CubeSat preliminary design workflow using standardized S3D sheets, a central data repository, and a COTS technology database. It handles limited early design knowledge through equations, typical values, and component data, but not as an explicit minimal-behavior modeling method.
key_findings_by_rq.RQ2: Claims CE-MBSE improves schedule, cost, decision support, consistency, communication, and reuse. Quantitative evidence is strongest for BOSS cost/time/mass comparison; outcomes are not EPS-specific and reliability evidence is mostly conceptual.
key_findings_by_rq.RQ3: No explicit EPS verification procedure model is presented. The closest mechanisms are pre-physical parametric consistency checks and generic claims that verification can begin earlier.

limitations_gaps_stated_by_authors: S3D tool needs improvement and optimization.
Optical payload spreadsheet needs updating and central-repository integration; other payload sheets are needed.
C&DH calculation sheet must be created.
Comet and Matlab System Composer are under investigation for enhanced systems engineering/later phases.
MySQL/other database solutions are being evaluated for scalable, reliable data management.
Comparison results only include four-session outputs, not post-study refinement.
extractor_identified_limitations_gaps: No public model/tool/database availability is reported.
No formal MBSE language such as SysML is used or reported.
No EPS-specific outcome or verification evidence is provided beyond EPS inclusion in the workflow.
No hardware/software integration, environmental test, operational, or flight evidence.
No independent validation or stakeholder evaluation.
Formal requirements and V&V traceability are not shown.

a design methodology particularly suitable for the phase 0/A

synthesis_consistency.lineage_notes: This paper belongs to the STAR/PoliTo C²DF, S3D Tool, and CUTE-DB family, with related 2024 papers on Geo-Profundo, project-based education, and database-driven concurrent MBSE.
synthesis_consistency.extraction_confidence_reason: Readable full text with substantial workflow/tool/case detail; uncertainty remains only where the paper uses broad MBSE/verification terms without formal artifacts.
